query:
INSERT INTO steering.enrolments
                       (session_id, steerer_id, mode_id, authority_id, enrolled_by)
                   SELECT s.id, $2, m.id, a.id, $5
                     FROM sessions.sessions    s,
                          steering.modes       m,
                          steering.authorities a
                    WHERE s.session_uuid = $1
                      AND m.code         = $3
                      AND a.code         = $4
                   RETURNING id
